gen_risks.description: Informal sector workers may be reluctant to enroll in the NPR and SR due to concerns that their data will be used for tax enforcement.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct targeted outreach campaigns informing informal workers about data confidentiality safeguards and the social protection benefits of registration.
gen_risks.evidence: workers in the informal sector, are wary of providing their information to the government due to perceived risks of making them susceptible to taxation.

gen_risks.description: Vulnerable groups such as illiterate persons, disabled individuals, and remote residents may face exclusion due to administrative and physical access barriers.
gen_risks.mitigation: Deploy mobile units, satellite communication, Citizen Service Centers, and inclusive engagement strategies under the Stakeholder Engagement Plan.
gen_risks.evidence: These groups could face administrative, cultural, economic, geographical, language, and social norm-related barriers when accessing services and benefits.

gen_risks.description: System expansion and digital data collection could lead to personal data protection breaches or data privacy compromises.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement privacy-by-design standards, ensure strict adherence to Law 09-08, and provide software security enhancements alongside staff training.
gen_risks.evidence: Potential negative social impacts from project activities are mainly related to... data protection issues.

gen_risks.description: Rapid growth of the registries could overstretch Ministry of Interior capacity and delay the full operationalization of the National Registry Agency.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide dedicated institutional capacity building and condition disbursement on specific performance-based conditions (PBCs) for NRA staffing and operations.
gen_risks.evidence: This rapid expansion has strained the government’s and the MoI’s capacity to take steps in operationalizing the NRA.

gen_risks.description: Reliance on Excel spreadsheets and manual data extraction from national systems for project financial management creates risks of reporting errors and delays.
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and install dedicated financial management software to automate IFR preparation and annual project financial reporting.
gen_risks.evidence: use of a spreadsheet “Excel” and data extracted from the national budget execution software may lead to some challenges in terms of quality and timeliness

gen_risks.description: Using shared budget lines (AMO-TADAMON) across multiple World Bank projects risks expenditure duplication or double-counting.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish distinct, dedicated budget codes within the Ministry of Interior budget specifically tied to project PBC-related expenditures.
gen_risks.evidence: risk of duplication or overlap due to the use of the same budget line “AMO-TADAMON” to justify expenditure... on programs already financed

gen_risks.description: Frequent climate shocks such as droughts may severely drop agricultural output and income, straining social safety net mechanisms.
gen_risks.mitigation: Utilize real-time location and welfare data in the NPR and SR to rapidly identify climate-affected households and dynamically deploy shock-responsive cash support.
gen_risks.evidence: climate-related shocks, primarily droughts, represent significant risks to the Moroccan economy

gen_risks.description: Deployment of mobile enrollment equipment and computing devices could generate unmanaged electronic waste.
gen_risks.mitigation: Enforce formal e-waste management procedures for IT hardware and batteries under existing asset management protocols.
gen_risks.evidence: Risks associated with the use of electronic devices (such as mobile units) include the potential generation of e-waste and its improper disposal.

gen_risks.description: Failure to establish automated death record updates from civil registries could leave deceased individuals in the NPR, compromising system integrity.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement automated electronic data exchanges between civil registry offices and the NPR, monitored via dedicated PBC milestones.
gen_risks.evidence: the removal of deceased registrants is equally important to ensure sustained efficiency.

gen_risks.description: Inaccuracies in the SR Proxy-Means Test scoring formula could result in inclusion and exclusion targeting errors for social protection programs.
gen_risks.mitigation: Perform process evaluations, re-evaluate scoring formulas against household survey data, and test revised questionnaires on representative beneficiary samples.
gen_risks.evidence: develop a strategy to reduce potential exclusion and inclusion errors

gen_risks.description: Complications in managing optional maintenance tranches for legacy IT contracts could disrupt critical biometric and database systems.
gen_risks.mitigation: Formulate a concise Project Procurement Strategy for Development (PPSD) outlining practical procedures for contract maintenance management.
gen_risks.evidence: managing the optional tranches relating to the maintenance of the contracts listed above.

gen_risks.description: Cyclical and climate-related income drops among non-salaried workers could prevent regular health insurance contribution payments.
gen_risks.mitigation: Use SR welfare scoring and dynamic data updates to identify vulnerable workers experiencing income shocks and offer temporary contribution support.
gen_risks.evidence: farmers... suffer from two patterns of irregularities in the flow of income: seasonal and annual cyclicality, which significantly affects their ability to pay.

gen_risks.description: Hiring contracted workers for technical and operational tasks could lead to non-compliance with World Bank labor and working condition standards.
gen_risks.mitigation: Incorporate ESS2 gap-filling measures into the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan, including worker grievance mechanisms and OHS guidelines.
gen_risks.evidence: Gap-filling measures, such as access to a GM, have been included in the ESCP to ensure appropriate labor and working conditions

gen_risks.description: Failure to finalize and adopt an acceptable Project Operational Manual within 60 days of effectiveness could cause project implementation delays.
gen_risks.mitigation: Expedite POM preparation by building upon operational guidelines from the prior operation and securing early World Bank review.
gen_risks.evidence: No later than sixty (60) days after the Effective Date... prepare a manual acceptable to the Bank (“Project Operational Manual” or “POM”)

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risk is assessed as Substantial. Given the complex nature of the operation and the involvement of multiple stakeholders in the implementation of the National Population Register (NPR) and the Social Registry (SR), the Project Management Unit (PMU) will need to put considerable effort into ensuring better coordination to achieve the PDO. The national rollout and the improvement of the NPR and the SR will need strong stakeholder engagement, including citizens concerned by social protection programs who are often poor and vulnerable.
gt_risks.mitigation: The communication strategy will continue to inform all stakeholders involved in project implementation and will capitalize on lessons learned from the first Identity and Targeting for Social Protection project (P155198). The PMU envisions improving the grievance mechanism at local and national levels and establishing a system to promote citizen engagement and transparency. The Inter-Ministerial Steering Committee is responsible for developing guidelines for the strategic policy for the envisaged reform and ensuring a link with the ongoing social protection reform. Technical work will also cover a process evaluation to identify challenges, propose remedies, and provide recommendations to enhance system implementation at central and local levels.
